text:
Alex: Quick cleanup PR up — split logging utils into smaller modules, added type hints, and fixed a couple of lingering flake8 warnings. Mostly renames and __init__ re-exports but there are a couple of changes to logger.init behavior. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/core/pull/312

Priya: Thanks — will take a look today. Can you summarize any runtime-impacting changes to import paths?

Alex: Sure — moved redwood.utils.logging -> redwood.logging.{core,handlers,formatters}. Added thin shim in redwood/utils/logging/__init__.py to preserve old imports, but I removed one implicit side-effect that used to configure root logger at module import time (that's the api change).

Jamal: pinging @Sara for SRE concerns — we import logging at bootstrap, could hit ordering issues.

Sara: Yep I can scan for bootstrap import order. If there was implicit config at import time that might change startup logs. I'll run a quick staging smoke after review.

ci-bot: CI: 7 failing tests, 2 lint errors — https://ci.internal/redwood/core/312

Alex: Thanks. The failing tests are mostly test_logging/test_init.py expecting the old side-effect. I pushed a deprecation shim but clearly missed an edge. Fix incoming in a couple mins.

Priya: Quick code nits from skimming the diff: prefer explicit relative imports inside the package (e.g., from .core import Logger), and avoid re-exporting with wildcard in __init__. Also, for the init change, add a tiny docstring about why side-effect was removed.

Jamal: I can pick up the style review after tests pass. Also suggest adding an integration test for bootstrap order — might be worth adding here or as a follow-up.

Alex: Pushed fixes + a small integration test that simulates early import order. @ci-bot request rerun.

ci-bot: All checks passed ✅ — build 1789

Priya: Left two tiny inline comments about explicit typing on the new handlers, but nothing blocking. LGTM otherwise.

Sara: Did a quick staging deploy and exercised startup. No import errors and logs look sane.

Alex: Awesome — planning to merge in ~30m unless anyone wants me to hold.

Jamal: Fine to merge. :thumbsup:

Priya: Go for it, thanks for the quick turnaround.

Alex: Merged. Thanks everyone!
